verdict: Ads are running and GBP demand is up; lead tracking needs repair now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Google Ads ran the full $1,521.37 in budget and recorded 15 conversions on the ad platform — but zero leads are showing in your dashboard because the connection between ad data and your lead pipeline is broken and is being repaired. Separately, your Google Business Profile had a strong week, with engagement up 41% over the prior week (38 calls, 32 direction requests, 35 website clicks), signaling real seasonal demand in your area. However, none of those 38 calls are currently being captured as leads in the system, meaning the actual volume of interested customers is higher than what the numbers reflect. With 41 opportunities created in your CRM this period and an intake role being confirmed by August 31, the priority right now is making sure every inbound call and form has someone to receive it and a tracking path to record it.

highlights.phrase: spent on Google Ads in the last 28 days, with 15 conversions recorded by the ad platform
calls came through your Google Business Profile this period — real demand that is not yet captured as leads
week-over-week rise in Google Business Profile engagement, the strongest movement this period

watch_item.issue: Lead tracking is disconnected — ad conversions and GBP calls are not flowing into your lead dashboard, making the pipeline appear empty when it is not.
watch_item.fix: Tracking is being repaired now, and an intake owner is being confirmed by August 31 to ensure every inbound contact is received and recorded going forward.
